frozenAcceptanceConstraints.strictSuccess: Expected HTTP completion, correct selected model, all required semantic/evidence/narrative constraints, and expected browser effects must pass. Extra unrequested action fields fail even if their values equal current controls.
frozenAcceptanceConstraints.semanticEquivalence: Accept only equivalences already listed in the frozen case oracle/plan constraints; narrative paraphrases are allowed when all required propositions remain true.
frozenAcceptanceConstraints.unsupportedTasks: Must provide the expected refusal or clarification and preserve all UI filters and bounds; never count a partial action as success.
frozenAcceptanceConstraints.supportedTasks: A refusal, 422, missing essential constraint, wrong source evidence, or unexpected filter change is failure.
frozenAcceptanceConstraints.sourceTruth: Frozen independent query/source oracle, not consistency between a returned plan and its own returned evidence.
frozenAcceptanceConstraints.controlExclusion: All four control cases are excluded from primary accuracy, primary latency and paired model-ranking inference. MD16 provides no model-comparison evidence.
frozenAcceptanceConstraints.modelAttribution: Returned model identity must match requested model; model label alone does not prove inference. Attribute known shared pre/postprocessor failures separately.

frozenFailureRubric.gradingRule: Record all applicable category tags and highest severity. Strict pass requires all frozen required checks; severity is a diagnostic annotation, not an alternate score. Optional caveats cannot be promoted to required after responses are seen.

frozenAnalysisPlan.primaryMetric: Mean of per-task three-trial strict-success means across 24 equally weighted primary tasks, by model.
frozenAnalysisPlan.latency: Report median and p90 complete end-to-end request time, successful-task latency, time-to-failure, and fraction of scheduled primary trials strictly successful within 30 seconds; do not remove failures from reliability denominators.

pairedUncertainty.method: paired task-cluster percentile bootstrap over task means

interpretationNotes: The noSourceOrWebPublishing flag records the frozen execution-stage prohibition on publishing mid-run. This deliberately sanitized derivative was separately authorized for release after inference; it does not change historical execution policy.
Exact action patch equality is stricter than observed state-change safety. UI-state violation counts measure actual control-value changes against the frozen policy, not user harm.
No browser observation is claimed for API-mode questions. API tasks supply frozen UI-like context, but noAction is a response contract rather than a browser before/after measurement.
Maryland evidence totals/filters/row multisets and selected required answer caveats are checked by the frozen structural grader; not every possible surplus prose claim is semantically validated.
HIN deterministic answers include exact template checks. Chinese-language compliance is a character-level check, not an independent fluency or translation assessment.
The public MD07 token and reduced oracle require private source binding for exact replay; the original accepted oracle is not replaced by the reduction.
Narrative propositions are scored by identity-blind AI-assisted review with historical calibration. This is not completed human expert adjudication or inter-rater reliability evidence.

required: Correct formula: serious injuries + 2 × non-motorist crashes + 10 × fatalities
Injuries/fatalities count people; non-motorist values count crashes
optional: Ranking normalization by mile and independent minimum-length sets

required: Retains the supplied database ranking version
optional: Audit counts not supplied to evaluated model

required: Substantive refusal of a next-month exposure-adjusted fatal-crash probability
optional: Specific validated-model recipe or data-collection prescription

required: Substantive refusal of a causal injury-reduction percentage because treatment/causal evidence is unavailable

functionalSensitivity.status: Secondary diagnostic introduced post hoc in the original analysis and inherited by later campaigns; does not replace strict scores.

rules.extraCondition: Plan operation is breakdown; all other frozen checks pass.
Metric is weightedScorePerMile; source row IDs, order, values and every other strict check pass.
set_filters clears location and contains only redundant estimate/placement equal to before-state; every actual state/URL/data check passes.
No action; supported refusal wording; all other checks including unchanged UI pass.
Plan and evidence use all scope but full county/yearly evidence and every other strict check match. Aggregate-only answers are not relaxed.

versionPolicy: Freeze this historical v1 review derivative. Record proposed revisions separately, increment the suite version, and freeze revised tasks/oracles before new inference. Any correction to a historical adjudication must be additive, documented, and preserve prior grades; never silently rewrite a frozen oracle or present post-outcome changes as preregistered.
